name: Conubia
tagline: The operating system of record for wedding professionals.
positioning: Conubia consolidates leads, contracts, timelines, and payments into a single governed workflow for the modern wedding vendor.

hero.h1: Every booking, contract, and vow — under one system of record.
hero.sub: Conubia gives independent planners, photographers, and venues an enterprise-grade CRM built for the wedding lifecycle: inquiry to final payment, fully auditable.

features.title: Inquiry-to-contract pipeline
features.description: Convert website inquiries into signed agreements without leaving the platform. Templated proposals, e-signatures, and version history on every document.

features.title: Milestone payment ledger
features.description: Automate deposit schedules, retainer reminders, and final balances. Every transaction reconciled against the couple's contract.

features.title: Ceremony timeline builder
features.description: Assemble minute-by-minute run-of-show timelines and distribute them to couples, vendors, and your second shooter in one governed link.

features.title: Vendor referral registry
features.description: Track the florists, officiants, and caterers you recommend, with performance notes and reciprocal-referral attribution.

features.title: Seasonal capacity planning
features.description: Model your booking calendar against peak-season demand so you never double-book a Saturday in June again.

features.title: Client portal of record
features.description: Give each couple a single branded portal for documents, invoices, and approvals — no more scattered email threads.

testimonials.quote: Before Conubia I ran my studio out of three spreadsheets and a shared inbox. Now every couple's contract, payment schedule, and timeline lives in one auditable place. My close rate went up in a single season.
testimonials.name: Delphine Marchetti

testimonials.quote: The milestone payment ledger alone paid for the subscription. I stopped chasing final balances by text message, and my books reconcile themselves.
testimonials.name: Harrison Boyd

testimonials.quote: We coordinate forty weddings a year with two planners. Conubia's timeline builder and vendor registry are the only reason that math works.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: For the independent vendor running the whole operation alone.
For growing studios with a small team and a full calendar.
For multi-planner firms and venues managing high volume.

homepage.footerBlurb: Conubia is the system of record for wedding professionals — governing every inquiry, contract, and payment from first hello to final dance.
